plan: [This is a second-price (Vickrey) auction. Bidding your true value is a dominant strategy and maximizes expected profit regardless of others' bids. Values are independent and there's only one round, so no dynamic considerations. I will bid my private value, rounded to the nearest $0.1, to ensure I win exactly when it is profitable (when second-highest bid < my value).]

[This is a sealed-bid second-price auction (Vickrey). Truthful bidding is a dominant strategy because you pay the second-highest bid, not your own, so bidding your true value maximizes expected profit. No prior history to learn from; ties resolved randomly and bids are in $0.1 increments. Therefore bid my private value exactly to maximize expected payoff.]

[This is a second-price (Vickrey) auction with independent private values and no prior history to learn from. Truthful bidding is a dominant strategy: bid your true value because your bid only affects whether you win, not the price you pay (you pay the second-highest bid). With value $24, bidding $24 maximizes expected surplus and avoids profitable deviations. ]
